caveat: This verifier creates a Stripe test-mode Checkout Session through the deployed create-checkout-session Supabase Edge Function and retrieves the session from Stripe to confirm livemode=false. It does not complete payment, prove live revenue, prove webhook fulfillment, or prove MRR.
manualInterventionIfSkipped: Create or choose a Stripe test-mode Price object and set STRIPE_TEST_PRICE_ID or APO_STRIPE_TEST_PRICE_ID.
Provide a Stripe test-mode secret or restricted key via explicit STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY or STRIPE_TEST_RESTRICTED_KEY; generic STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is intentionally ignored by this test proof.
Provide a dedicated Supabase Auth synthetic test user via LIVE_SUPABASE_TEST_USER_EMAIL and LIVE_SUPABASE_TEST_USER_PASSWORD.
Confirm the deployed create-checkout-session function has its own STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY secrets configured.
Preserve raw Checkout Session payloads, function invocation metadata, and any screenshots/Stripe dashboard evidence outside git; commit only the generated redacted artifact.
Run npm run verify:stripe-test-checkout. Do not paste secret values into chat or tracked files.

checks.label: Stripe test checkout credentials are configured
checks.message: Missing: SUPABASE_URL or VITE_SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY or VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, LIVE_SUPABASE_TEST_USER_EMAIL or STRIPE_TEST_USER_EMAIL, LIVE_SUPABASE_TEST_USER_PASSWORD or STRIPE_TEST_USER_PASSWORD, STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY or STRIPE_TEST_RESTRICTED_KEY, STRIPE_TEST_PRICE_ID or APO_STRIPE_TEST_PRICE_ID
